attributes.body:
SlideUpLift launches Creatos AI, the AI presentation maker that never starts from a blank page.

Jersey City, N.J., Aug. 14, 2026 - SlideUpLift, a presentation platform trusted by more than 100,000 professionals, today announced the launch of Creatos AI, an AI presentation maker built on SlideUpLift's library of more than 40,000 professionally designed slides.

As AI makes presentation content faster to create, professionals still face a familiar challenge: producing decks that look polished, stay on brand and remain easy to edit. Creatos AI addresses that problem by starting with professionally designed slides rather than a blank prompt, then using AI to help users adapt content, visuals and branding.

Users can begin with formats such as pitch decks, roadmaps, timelines, SWOT analyses, business reviews and 30-60-90 day plans. They can then customize presentations with AI-assisted editing or direct inline editing.

"AI should make presentation creation faster without forcing professionals to give up good design or control over the finished deck," said Manglam Vashisht, Founder of SlideUpLift. "With Creatos AI, we start with professionally designed presentations and use AI to help people make that design their own. The goal is to remove repetitive work while keeping the presentation editable, brand-ready and useful in real business workflows."

## Professional Design as the Starting Point

Creatos AI is built on SlideUpLift's library of more than 40,000 professionally designed slides. Instead of starting from an empty canvas, users begin with an existing presentation structure that can be adapted to a specific story, audience or business requirement.

The platform combines SlideUpLift's design library with AI-assisted customization, helping professionals spend more time refining their message and less time rebuilding slide layouts.

## AI and Manual Editing Together

Users can ask Creatos AI to rewrite or shorten content, replace an image, apply a brand theme, animate a slide or populate a template for a specific topic. They can also directly edit text, headings, shapes, icons, images, charts, colors and layouts.

After AI-assisted changes are made, slide elements remain editable so users can continue refining the presentation manually.

## One-Click Branding and Reusable Assets

Creatos AI lets users apply brand fonts, colors and logos across a presentation. Logos, icons and images can also be stored in a media library and reused across future decks, helping teams maintain consistency across recurring presentations.

## Editable PowerPoint and Google Slides Output

Finished presentations can be exported to PowerPoint and Google Slides as editable files rather than static images or PDFs. This allows users to continue editing, collaborate with colleagues and make changes in the presentation software they already use.

## Built for Recurring Business Presentation Work

Creatos AI is designed for consultants, marketers, product and project managers, business teams and frequent PowerPoint users. Common use cases include pitch decks, project updates, business reviews, roadmaps, timelines, marketing presentations, SWOT analyses and 30-60-90 day plans.

## Availability and Pricing

Creatos AI is available now at slideuplift.com/ai-presentation-maker. New accounts include two starter AI credits with no credit card required. Inline editing does not consume AI credits. Credits are used when AI performs work for the user and for applicable edited-deck exports, with exact credit requirements displayed before an AI action is confirmed.

## Built on an Established Presentation Platform

Creatos AI extends SlideUpLift's existing presentation platform and template library, used by more than 100,000 professionals.

"The designs are fantastic, helping my PowerPoint slides pop without the need for endless tweaking or design expertise," said Melissa Ann Jackson, Senior Marketing Manager.

About Creatos AI

Creatos AI is SlideUpLift's AI presentation editor. Built on a library of more than 40,000 professionally designed slides, it combines AI-assisted editing, direct inline editing, brand customization and editable presentation output.

About SlideUpLift

SlideUpLift is a presentation platform offering professionally designed PowerPoint and Google Slides templates, AI-powered presentation tools and presentation design services for business professionals. Its library includes more than 40,000 presentation templates, including more than 10,000 free PowerPoint templates, covering strategy, project management, marketing, pitch decks, timelines, roadmaps, executive summaries and business reviews.

For more information, visit SlideUpLift.com

Top 5 websites for the best PowerPoint and ai-enhanced presentation templates in 2025.

Last updated on: September 26, 2025

Creating professional and visually appealing presentations is essential for business, education, and creative projects. With so many tools available today, finding the right platform that offers quality templates and modern designs can save time and elevate your slides.

Modern presentation platforms now offer vast libraries of templates, including free options, covering business, consulting, marketing, education, and creative projects. Many platforms also include presentation services, such as professional formatting, custom slide creation, and visual storytelling guidance.

With optional AI-powered features, these tools can suggest layouts, graphics, and charts, allowing users to focus on content and messaging while saving time. The right platform can transform how quickly you create polished, impactful presentations.Here's a curated list of 5 must-try platforms for modern presentation templates in 2025.

1. SlideUpLift - premium templates with AI support.

SlideUpLift offers a vast library of free and paid professionally designed PowerPoint and Google Slides templates, suitable for business, consulting, and educational use. Recently, SlideUpLift also introduced a Neo AI Presentation maker, which helps users generate slides faster by suggesting layouts and designs based on content, while keeping full control over customization.

* Hundreds of ready-to-use consulting, strategy and business templates.

* Vast library of Free templates available alongside premium collections.

* Neo AI Presentation Maker to make presentations at the speed of thought.

* Fully editable slides for PowerPoint and Google Slides.

* Infographics, icons, images and animations are included in the library.

* Presentation services ranging from corporate partnerships to pay per slide available.

Use Case: Perfect for consultants, corporate teams, educators, and anyone who needs polished, presentation-ready slides quickly, with access to both free and premium templates.

2. Canva - versatile templates with optional AI assistance.

Canva continues to be a popular design platform for presentations. It has hundreds of templates and a simple drag-and-drop editor. Canva has also started integrating AI-assisted design suggestions, helping users with slide layout and graphics.

Use Case: Best for marketers, educators, and creative teams who need flexible and visually appealing presentations.

3. Beautiful.ai - streamlined layout templates.

Beautiful.ai helps users maintain a consistent and polished slide design. It also offers AI features that automatically adjust layouts as content is added.

Use Case: Useful for small teams or individuals who want professional-looking slides without spending too much time on formatting.

4. Visme - data-driven visual presentations.

Visme combines templates with infographics, charts, and visuals. While primarily a template platform, it includes AI-assisted charts and infographic suggestions to help users quickly visualize data.

Use Case: Ideal for analysts, educators, and marketers who need to present information clearly and attractively.

5. Zoho Show - cloud-based template platform.

Zoho Show is a cloud-based presentation tool offering professional templates. It recently introduced minor AI features to assist with formatting and design suggestions.

Use Case: Suitable for teams seeking a lightweight, collaborative presentation platform.

For professionals looking for high-quality, ready-to-use PowerPoint templates, there are several platforms that provide extensive libraries of business-focused and educational templates, including both free and premium options. Many of these platforms now offer AI-assisted tools that help streamline slide creation by suggesting layouts and designs based on content, while still allowing full customization.

Other features, such as editable slides, infographics, charts, and workflow diagrams, make it easier for users to create polished, professional presentations efficiently. By exploring these options, professionals, educators, and teams can select platforms that best meet their workflow, design needs, and time constraints.
